mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it indicates a weakening labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (HOUST < 700 and INDPRO < 95) fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%), a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized signals inflationary pressures that prompt further rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 1.5, the signal (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized) fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls above 100,000 jobs compresses the unemployment rate and expands consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of months with PAYEMS growth above 100,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 650,000 units, it indicates a contraction in the residential sector that dampens overall economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 650, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 400,000 million dollars and a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%) signals weak consumer demand and restrictive monetary policy, suppressing corporate earnings and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (RSAFS < 400 and FEDFUNDS > 1.0) fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-side contraction (INDPRO < 95), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.0%) indicates a severe economic shock that reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 95, the signal (UNRATE > 8.0) fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
